context.content_translation:
Improvements in irrigation technology throughout the region were followed by ------- gains in corn production.
A. proportionally
B. proportional
C. proportioning
D. proportions

items.question: Improvements in irrigation technology throughout the region were followed by ------- gains in corn production.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“proportional”代入题干后为“Improvements in irrigation technology throughout the region were followed by proportional gains in corn production.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（proportional）。
